svg.title: Crystal's twilight atelier
svg.desc: A folded-ear tabby kitten leans from a felt bed toward a ball of yarn, beneath an arched evening window and a small crystal mobile. The upper left is left quiet for a headline.

svg.title: Crystal, a lounging folded-ear brown tabby
svg.desc: Original illustrated adult plush cat, reclining three-quarter belly-up. Four distinct paws: two curled foreground forepaws on the chest and two outward resting hind paws; a long thick striped tail curls to the right. Amber eyes, folded short ears, cream speckled belly. Transparent background.
